infinity_nikki_design_rules: A Resonant Form may provide a capability snapshot; it may not own traversal or progression authority.
Gathering creates a typed item transaction and a cosmetic/UX event; it does not directly mutate a BP-local count.
A recipe consumes definitions through one inventory authority and must be repeatable/idempotent across save/load.
Every contextual action has a readable blocked reason and, where appropriate, an alternate route.
Cosmetic wardrobe state is separate from campaign progression and capability unlock truth.
New content should be a data addition plus a fixture, not a new subsystem or duplicate currency.
Niagara/material/animation polish observes typed impact or state events and never decides gameplay outcome.
definition_of_done: New skill, enemy, gathering node, portal, or challenge can be added without editing battle/traversal/save authority code.
The readiness scanner detects missing parent/interface/ID/fixture evidence before promotion.
The editor fixture and Development package reproduce the same route result.
Save/load and reset are proven with stable IDs and no duplicate reward/state transaction.
The player-facing golden route remains separate from the IntegrationMap proof route.
mutation_policy: No stale-editor live mutation, no _TASK_QUEUE.md edit, no Claude-owned C++/Python/shared-ledger overwrite, and no Melusina V2/ABP/Kawaii/material mutation.
